description: Sandbox.envdAccessToken / trafficAccessToken and SandboxDetail.envdAccessToken are the credentials for a sandbox's envd daemon and its public URLs (sent as X-Access-Token / e2b-traffic-access-token by the official SDK, packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/index.ts), but the spec carries no sensitive mark. Source: spec/openapi.yml (e2b-dev/E2B, 2026-11-02).
